stages.headline: Induction proves inequalities: 2ⁿ > n for every natural n, since 2^(k+1) = 2 · 2ᵏ > 2k ≥ k + 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: Induction proves inequalities: 2ⁿ > n for every natural n, since 2^(k+1) = 2 · 2ᵏ > 2k ≥ k + 1.

stages.headline: Bernoulli's inequality: (1 + x)ⁿ ≥ 1 + nx for x > −1; e.g. 1.01¹⁰⁰ ≥ 1 + 100 · 0.01 = 2.
stages.headlineEnglish: Bernoulli's inequality: (1 + x)ⁿ ≥ 1 + nx for x > −1; e.g. 1.01¹⁰⁰ ≥ 1 + 100 · 0.01 = 2.

stages.headline: Induction may start from any n₀, not only 1: 2ⁿ > n² holds for n ≥ 5.
